auth.missingClientId: PlayPick is not configured yet. Set VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in your environment file.
auth.scriptUnavailable: Could not reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
auth.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the Google sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
auth.popupClosed: Sign-in was cancelled before it finished.
auth.accessDenied: PlayPick needs access to your YouTube playlists to continue.
auth.profileUnavailable: Signed in, but your Google profile could not be loaded. Please try again.

youtube.network: Could not reach YouTube. Check your connection and try again.
youtube.authExpired: Your Google session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
youtube.quotaExceeded: PlayPick has reached today's YouTube request limit. Please try again tomorrow.
youtube.apiNotEnabled: PlayPick is not set up to reach YouTube yet. The YouTube Data API has to be enabled for this deployment — signing in again will not help.
youtube.insufficientPermissions: PlayPick is not allowed to read your playlists. Sign in again and grant YouTube access.
youtube.notFound: That playlist is no longer available on YouTube. Refresh to update the list.
youtube.service: YouTube is having trouble right now. Please try again in a moment.
youtube.unknown: Your playlists could not be loaded. Please try again.

reorder.partial: Applied {{completed}} of {{total}} changes. {{failed}} did not go through.

hero.title: Take control of your YouTube playlists
hero.subtitle: Reorder, copy, organize, and build playlists with a simple drag-and-drop experience.

landing.permission: PlayPick only requests the YouTube permissions required to manage your playlists.

dashboard.heading: What would you like to do?
dashboard.subtitle: Pick a tool to start organizing your playlists.

reorder.title: Reorder Playlist
reorder.description: Rearrange videos in one of your existing playlists using drag and drop.

copy.title: Copy Between Playlists
copy.description: Copy videos from one playlist to another without removing them from the original playlist.

create.title: Create Playlist
create.description: Create a new YouTube playlist and start adding videos to it.

build.title: Build Playlist
build.description: Choose videos from your existing playlists and combine them into a new playlist.

merge.title: Merge Playlists
merge.description: Combine videos from multiple playlists into a single playlist.

duplicate.title: Duplicate Playlist
duplicate.description: Create a copy of an existing playlist.

reorder.title: Reorder Playlist
reorder.selectFirst: First, select the playlist you want to reorder.
reorder.subtitle: Drag videos to change their order.

announce.pickedUp: Picked up {{title}}. It is at position {{position}} of {{total}}.

save.estimate_one: This will apply {{count}} change on YouTube.
save.estimate_other: This will apply {{count}} changes on YouTube.
save.quotaExceeded: PlayPick has reached today's YouTube limit. Trying again today will not help — the limit resets tomorrow.
save.unknown: Something went wrong sending your changes to YouTube.
save.insufficientPermissions: PlayPick is not allowed to change your playlists. Sign in again and grant YouTube access.
save.notFound: Part of this playlist no longer exists on YouTube. Go back and load it again.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.message: The playlist will go back to the order it was in. This cannot be undone.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: Your changes have not been sent to YouTube. Leaving will lose them.

success.description: The new order is now on YouTube.

empty.title: No playlists yet
empty.description: This account does not own any playlists. Create one on YouTube, then refresh.

noMatches.title: No playlists match your search
noMatches.description: Try a different word, or clear the search to see all of them again.
noMatches.partial: Only the playlists loaded so far were searched. Load more to search the rest.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
